# Set Brightness

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Sets the devices bluetooth to the given double.

## Syntax

~~~~text
setBrightness(value: <#Number#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
setBrightness(value: 0.8)
~~~~
